  "explanation": "The caller said a parcel will be delivered by 5 PM today and asked if the person will be home. There is no request for money, codes, or apps."

{"items":[{"text":"Hello, I am Inspector Vikram Singh from the CBI Delhi. Your Aadhaar has been linked to a Rs 45 lakh hawala network in Gurgaon. We have your video on CCTV. If you breathe a word to your family, we will arrest your wife today itself. Keep the phone on and do not hang up. The cyber cell is watching your screen right now. Cooperate or face treason charges. Stay silent."},{"text":"Sir, hum CBI team se bol rahe hain. Aapka PAN card ek fake company ke saath match ho gaya hai, jiska turnover 3 crore tha. Abhi hum aapko video call pe dekh sakte hain. Kisi ko mat bataiyega, warna case aapki beti pe shift ho jayega. OTP mat dijiya, bas screen share rakhiye. Hum Mumbai police ke saath connected hain. Chup rahiye aur instructions follow kijiye."},{"text":"Sir, मैं CBI officer बोल रहा हूँ। आपका आधार एक 50 लाख के फर्जी लोन नेटवर्क से जुड़ा हुआ है। हम आपको वीडियो कॉल पर देख रहे हैं। किसी को मत बताइएगा, वरना आपके बेटे को गिरफ्तार कर लेंगे। साइबर सेल आपकी स्क्रीन मॉनिटर कर रही है। चुप रहिए और स्क्रीन शेयर मत कटाइएगा।"},{"text":"Caller: Good evening, this is Sub-Inspector Mehta from the Enforcement Directorate. We have flagged your account for a suspicious transaction of Rs 22 lakh linked to a Chennai shell company. Please keep your video on, sir. Caller: I am looking at your living room right now through the app. Do not tell your wife or the neighbours, otherwise we will issue a recovery warrant against your son's school. Person: Arre, what are you saying? How did you get my home address? Caller: That is classified, sir. Just stay on the line and open the payment link I am sending. Person: I am not clicking anything. Caller: Then we will have to freeze your SIM within the hour. Person: Fine, tell me what you want exactly."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Hello this is Ramesh from the electricity board. Your bill for this month is still pending. We have tried calling you three times. Tonight at nine your power will be cut completely. If you want to stop this just call nine eight seven six five four three two one zero immediately. Do not wait otherwise your whole area will face darkness"},{"text":"नमस्ते sir मैं बिजली बोर्ड से बोल रहा हूँ आपका पिछला बिल अटका हुआ है आज रात नौ बजे लाइन कट जाएगी आप तुरंत इस नंबर पर कॉल कीजिए वरना पूरा मोहल्ला अंधेरे में रहेगा प्लीज जल्दी करिए sir"},{"text":"sir mera naam Vikram hai aur main tariff office se bol raha hoon. aapka pending bill 4500 rupees ka hai aur aaj raat 10 baje current cut ho jayega. agar aapko rokna hai toh turant is number 8765432109 par call karo ya phir recharge app download karke payment kar do. jaldi karo warna line band ho jayegi"},{"text":"Caller: Namaste, I am speaking from the state electricity office. Your consumer number ends in 4421 has a pending amount of twelve hundred rupees. Tonight at eight we will cut the supply. Please call this number to speak with the help desk. Person: Twelve hundred? But I paid last week. Caller: That payment is under review sir. If you do not call now, the disconnect team is already on the way. Person: Okay, I will call that number right now."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"sir meri galti se aapke account me 45000 rupaye aa gaye hain, maine abhi aapka number dial kiya tha, wo amount wapas karne ke liye aapko app pe ek request ayegi, usko approve kar dijiye, warna main police complaint karunga aur aapka account freeze ho jayega"},{"text":"hello this is your cashback department and we have an approved refund of 1200 rupees coming to your registered mobile number, to release it immediately you need to accept the pending payment request on your banking app, just tap approve and then dial the six digit code we will send to you, do not delay otherwise the offer expires in ten minutes"},{"text":"namaste ji mera naam rahul hai aur maine galti se aapke aadhar se linked account me 80000 rupaye bhej diye hain, usko wapas lene ke liye aapke phone pe ek request aayegi, usko turant approve kar dijiye, agar aapne reject kiya toh legal action hoga aur aapka sim block ho jayega, please abhi app kholiye"},{"text":"hello sir mera naam vikram hai aur maine aapke number pe galti se 15000 bhej diye hain, abhi aapke phone pe ek payment request aayegi, usko approve kar dijiye please, agar aapne nahi kiya toh mera boss bahut gussa hoga aur police case ho jayega, thoda jaldi kariye sir, bas ek tap karna hai app pe, theek hai"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hello sir I am calling from tech support regarding your aadhar card sir your account will be blocked today if you dont install teamviewer right now sir please download it fast sir we need remote access to fix the issue sir"},{"text":"नमस्ते sir मेरा नाम राजेश है और मैं support से बोल रहा हूँ आपका account अड़तालीस घंटे में बंद हो जाएगा बस अभी anydesk install कर लीजिए फिर हम आपका refund verify करेंगे sir थोड़ा time लगेगा बस hold कीजिए sir"},{"text":"bhai main support se bol raha hoon tere bank ka fraud detect hua hai bas abhi remote app download kar le aur screen share kar tere 45000 rupees refund ke liye verification hogi jaldi kar bhai"},{"text":"Caller: sir your hdfc card is compromised and we need to remote into your phone now Person: what do you mean compromised sir Caller: a hacker in mumbai used your details so please install quick support and give the code Person: okay sir I will download it now Caller: good sir do it fast before the money vanishes"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"नमस्ते रमेश जी, मैं भारत फाइनेंस से बोल रहा हूँ। आपका पांच लाख का pre approved loan ready है। बस दस हजार रुपये की processing fee और insurance GST पहले जमा करो। तभी पैसा सीधा खाते में आएगा। जल्दी करो, कल तक offer खत्म हो जाएगा। तुरंत बताइए, fee भेजेंगे या नहीं?"},{"text":"hello sir mera naam rajesh hai aur aapka saade chaar lakh ka loan pre approved ho chuka hai bas aapko pehle sadhe teen hazaar rupees processing aur gst fee deni hogi tabhi paisa release hoga agar der ki toh offer lapse ho jayega toh jaldi bataiye fee transfer kar rahe ho ya nahi"},{"text":"dekhiye sir aapka loan 3 lakh ka pre approved hai bas 2500 rupees processing aur insurance GST pehle dena hoga tabhi cash account mein aayega aur yeh offer aaj raat tak hi valid hai toh bina time waste kiye bataiye fee bhej rahe hain ya nahi"},{"text":"caller: hello bhai mera naam vikram hai aur aapka loan 2 lakh ka pre approved hai bas 1500 rupees processing fee aur gst pehle do tabhi paisa aayega person: thik hai kitna time hai mere paas caller: bas abhi do minute hain warna offer cancel ho jayega toh jaldi batao person: theek hai main abhi google pay se bhej deta hoon"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Hi, I am Raj from JobHub Mumbai. We have a part-time online role for you, just liking videos and writing small reviews. You will earn 8,000 rupees per week. But first, you need to pay a 500 rupee activation fee for your training kit, and then 1,200 for the security deposit. Once you send that, payouts start in two days. Send it now to this UPI ID, don't delay."},{"text":"Hello, main TalentSquad se Rahul bol raha hoon. Ye part-time online job hai, videos like karna aur chote reviews likhna hai. Weekly payout 10,000 tak hai. Par pehle aapko 300 rupees ka registration charge aur 800 ka security deposit dena hoga. Payouts tabhi start honge jab fee clear ho jayegi. Apna bank detail aur UPI ID abhi share karo, process fast karna hai."},{"text":"नमस्कार, मैं कामगार पोर्टल से सुरेश बोल रहा हूँ। यह पार्ट-टाइम ऑनलाइन जॉब है, वीडियो लाइक करना और रिव्यू लिखना है। आपको हर हफ्ते 7,500 रुपये मिलेंगे। लेकिन payout शुरू करने से पहले आपको 1,000 रुपये का रजिस्ट्रेशन फीस और 2,000 रुपये का सिक्योरिटी डिपॉजिट देना होगा। यह एडवांस फीस है। तुरंत अपना बैंक अकाउंट नंबर और UPI ID भेजें, वरना सीट किसी और को दे देंगे।"},{"text":"Caller: Hi, this is Vicky from QuickTask. We have a part-time online job for you, liking videos and doing small reviews. You will earn 6,000 rupees weekly.\nPerson: I am not interested, I already have a job.\nCaller: Sir, this is a limited offer only for today. You just need to pay a 400 rupee setup fee and 1,000 rupees security deposit first. After that, your first payout will come in 48 hours. Please share your UPI ID now so we can start immediately."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hello sir mera naam Rajesh hai aur main Reliance ke head office se bol raha hoon aapka number KBC lucky draw mein select hua hai aur aapko paanch crore rupaye mile hain bas processing fee ke liye aapko aaj hi atharah hazaar rupaye Google Pay karne honge warna prize kisi aur ko chala jayega"},{"text":"हाँ sir aapka number lucky draw में आया है और आपको पचास लाख रुपये मिलने वाले हैं बस tax भरने के लिए पहले बारह हजार रुपये भेजने होंगे वरना यह ऑफर खत्म हो जाएगा और किसी और को मिल जाएगा आप जल्दी करें"},{"text":"sir aapka number lottery mein select ho gaya hai aur aapko 2 crore milne wale hain bas ek chhoti si processing fee hai 25 hazaar rupees jo aapko aaj hi transfer karni hogi warna prize cancel ho jayega aur aapka account block bhi ho sakta hai please jaldi kijiye"},{"text":"Caller: namaskar sir aapka number KBC final draw mein aaya hai aur aapko ek crore rupaye milne hain bas ek hazaar rupaye ka tax pending hai jo aapko abhi Google Pay karna hoga Person: ek crore? par maine toh koi form bhara hi nahi tha Caller: woh toh internal selection hai sir jaldi kijiye warna aaj raat tak amount kisi aur ke naam transfer ho jayega Person: theek hai main abhi bhej deta hoon"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"नमस्ते सर मेरा नाम राजन है और रमेश जी ने आपका नंबर दिया था वो बोल रहे थे कि आप हमारे warehouse में supervisor की vacancy के लिए अप्लाई किया था अब बस आखिरी step है interview का तो आपसे request है कि आप तुरंत ये call अपने manager के नंबर पे merge कर दीजिए ताकि हम आगे की process शुरू कर सकें और आपकी joining जल्दी हो सके"},{"text":"hello sir my name is rajan and ramesh sir shared your contact saying you applied for the warehouse supervisor post and we just need to do one final step which is the interview so i request you to please merge this call with your manager right now so we can proceed further and complete your joining quickly"},{"text":"नमस्ते sir मेरा नाम राजन है और रमेश जी ने आपका number दिया था वो कह रहे थे कि आपने warehouse supervisor vacancy के लिए apply किया है अब बस आखिरी step है interview का तो आपसे request है कि आप तुरंत ये call अपने manager के number पे merge कर दीजिए ताकि हम आगे की process शुरू कर सकें"},{"text":"Caller: हेलो मैम मेरा नाम राजन है रमेश जी ने आपका number दिया थाWarehouse supervisor की vacancy के लिएअब बस आखिरी step है interview कातो आपसे request है कि आप तुरंत ये call अपने manager के number पे merge कर दीजिएCaller: Person: नमस्कार कौन बोल रहा हैCaller: रमेश जी ने बताया कि आपने apply किया हैअब बस interview merge करवा दीजिएPerson: ठीक है बताइए क्या बात हैCaller: बस जल्दी merge कीजिए वरना seat किसी और को मिल जाएगी"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hello sir this is rakesh from swift courier your parcel is on the way the driver will reach your flat between two and four pm today please keep the tracking number handy and keep the phone nearby just in case he needs to call you thanks"},{"text":"hello bhai main rahul hoon swiggy wala order lekar aa gaya hoon building ke neeche khada hoon aap please jaldi neeche aa jaiye main gate ke paas hoon thoda wait kar raha hoon aap aa jao main idhar hi hoon"},{"text":"namaste ji main bharat gas agency se bol raha hoon aapka cylinder kal subah das baje tak pahunch jayega delivery confirm karne ke liye bas apna registered mobile number verify kar dijiye taaki hum register mein update kar sakein aapka dhanyavad"},{"text":"hello sir aapka order aa gaya tha par wo item out of stock ho gaya hai toh maine uske badle dusra brand daal diya hai wo wala thoda sasta bhi hai agar aap chahein toh main usi ko pack kar deta hoon aap bataiye theek rahega"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Hello, this is Rajan from the cyber crime branch. Your Aadhar linked loan of fifty thousand rupees is three days overdue. If you do not transfer the full amount to our secure account within the next two hours, we will file an FIR against you and publish your defaulter details on the police portal. Your family members will also receive the notice. Please do not call back, just send the money immediately."},{"text":"sir main aap se bank ke legal department se baat kar raha hoon aapka naam Suresh hai aur aapne jo loan liya tha uski kist due hai abhi agar aapne paisa nahi bheja toh hum police station mein case darj karwa denge aur aapke padosiyon ko bhi bata denge ki aap defaulter hain bas jaldi se account mein transfer kar dijiye warna problem badi ho jayegi"},{"text":"sir aapka loan pending hai aur EMI clear nahi hui hai agar aapne abhi payment nahi kiya toh hum police case file kar denge aur aapka naam defaulter list mein daal denge sab relatives ko bhi message chala jayega bas jaldi se paise transfer kardo warna legal notice aayega"},{"text":"Caller: Madam, this is Inspector Mehta from the regional fraud squad. Your KYC verification for the ten lakh rupee personal loan is incomplete. Person: But I already paid the first instalment last month. Caller: That does not matter, madam. We have a warrant ready. If you do not remit the remaining balance to this escrow account within sixty minutes, we will raid your residence and handpick your photo to the local newspaper. Person: I cannot send money like this, I need to speak to my husband. Caller: No time for that, madam. The transfer link expires in forty minutes or we arrest you tomorrow morning."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Namaste sir, main State Bank of India se bol rahi hoon. Aapka KYC update pending hai, toh please ek baar branch visit karke Aadhaar aur PAN ka copy submit kar dijiye. Ya phir aap official app mein jaake bhi update kar sakte hain, wahan self-KYC ka option mil jayega. Sir, time par kar lena, warna account par temporary restriction lag sakta hai. Thank you sir."},{"text":"Good morning, this is HDFC Bank calling regarding your current account. Your monthly statement for the period ending 15th August is now ready and has been emailed to your registered address at abc@email.com. You can download it directly from there. If you did not receive it, please let us know and we will resend it immediately. Thank you for banking with us."},{"text":"Namaste Sharma ji, main aapka relationship manager Ravi bol raha hoon. Aapka jo fixed deposit tha, wo 20,000 rupees ka, wo 10 din mein mature ho raha hai. Aap chahein toh branch aakar renew kara sakte hain. Hum interest rate bhi discuss kar lenge. Agar aapko branch aana possible nahi hai, toh app se auto-renew bhi ho sakta hai. Bataiye, kab aa sakte hain?"},{"text":"Caller: Hello, this is the fraud team from ICICI Bank. Did you make a payment of 4,500 rupees today to the merchant reference 8842?\nPerson: Nahi, maine toh aaj aisa koi payment nahi kiya. Kya hua?\nCaller: The amount got debited from your account. Agar aapne nahi kiya, toh turant apna card official app se block kar dijiye. Hum code ya OTP kuch nahi maang rahe. Bas app mein jaake block kar dijiye."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"dear customer this is a reminder from your bank please never share your otp pin or cvv with anyone even if they claim to be from our support team real staff will never ask for these details over the phone if you get any such request immediately call our official helpline and block the number stay safe"},{"text":"caller hey maa aap dhyan se suno agar koi phone karke bole ki woh police ya bank se hai toh unko koi code ya paisa mat dena kyunki woh sab fraud log hain real police kabhi video call pe arrest nahi karti aur na hi code maangti hai so please kisi ko bhi apna otp ya account details mat dena okay"},{"text":"namaskar main aapko batana chahta hoon ki digital arrest jaisi koi cheez asli nahi hai agar koi video call par aapko arrest karne ki dhamki de raha hai toh samajh jaiye ki woh pakka scam hai asli agencies kabhi bhi video call par arrest nahi karti isliye aise logon ko turant block karein aur apni bank detail kisi ko mat dein"},{"text":"hey arjun kal mujhe ek call aaya tha ek aadmi bol raha tha ki wo income tax se hai aur mere account mein kuch problem hai par maine usko koi detail nahi diya aur direct 1930 pe report kar diya kyunki mujhe samajh aa gaya tha ki wo pakka fraud tha ab bas thoda tension hai par maine sahi kiya na"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hello this is priya from hr at techflow solutions i am calling to schedule your interview for the senior analyst role on thursday at eleven in the morning our hr manager will send the meeting link directly to your email so just keep an eye on your inbox and let me know if that time works for you thanks"},{"text":"haan rahul bhai meeting aaj shift karni hai kyunki mera ek chhota kaam aa gaya hai toh abhi hum log shaam ko paanch baje connect kar lenge instead of three pm please update your calendar and let me know if that works for you thik hai"},{"text":"namaste yadav ji bas yaad dilane ke liye call kiya tha ki is mahine ka kiraya due hai agla mahine ki panch tareekh tak dena hai aap wahi purane account mein transfer kar dijiyega jismein pehle bhejte the agar koi dikkat ho toh mujhe bata dijiyega dhanyawad"},{"text":"hello sir maintenance ka amount is month ready hai aap isko society office mein cash ya phir society app se pay kar sakte hain bas dhyan rakhiyega ki due date miss na ho kyunki late fee lag sakti hai agar aapko koi help chahiye toh office mein aake mil lijiyega ok bye"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Hello, aapka Jio ka 1.5GB daily wala plan kal expire ho raha hai. Recharge karne ke liye bas official MyJio app open karo aur wahan se payment kar do. Koi aur link mat click karna. Sirf app se hi karna, theek hai? Dhanyawaad, have a good day."},{"text":"Good evening sir, this is BSES Delhi calling regarding your electricity bill. The due date is the 15th of this month, so kindly pay it through our official app or visit your nearest counter. Late payment charges will apply after the due date, so please clear it on time. Thank you for your cooperation."},{"text":"Namaste, main Airtel broadband se baat kar raha hoon. Aapke router mein thoda issue aa raha tha, isliye main aaj shaam 4 baje aapke ghar visit karne aa raha hoon. Is service ka koi extra charge nahi hai, bilkul free hai. Bas aap ghar par rehna taaki connection check kar sakoon. Dhanyawaad."},{"text":"Caller: Hello, this is Tata Play. Your DTH account needs a recharge urgently, otherwise the channels will stop by tomorrow. Person: Oh, I didn't know. How can I do it? Caller: You can simply recharge through the Tata Play app using your registered mobile number. No need to share any OTP with anyone. Person: Okay, I will do it right now. Thank you."}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hey raj i was thinking we could hit that italian place near the metro today around seven if you are free my treat but we can just split the bill later since i know you hate asking for cash right so let me know asap"},{"text":"caller: beta tumne lunch kiya kya aaj
person: haan maa abhi kha liya
caller: theek hai aur ghar kab tak aaoge
person: main office ke baad seedha aaunga lagbhag saat baje tak"},{"text":"bhaiya main ghar aate waqt raste se mere liye woh blue shirt le aana jo maine almari mein rakhi thi aur agar dukan band ho toh tension mat lena main kal le lungi"},{"text":"hey uncle ji i was just calling to say that we are having the wedding at our farmhouse next month and you should definitely come with the whole family there will be lots of food and music so just mark your calendars and let us know if you need any help with travel or stay and please bring the kids too"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"hello madam thank you for calling customer care regarding your recent complaint number four eight two nine one we have processed your refund to the original payment method and it should reach your account within five to seven working days please keep your card details handy for verification thank you for your patience"},{"text":"hello bhai mera return request accept ho gaya hai ab kal slot book karna hai aapke paas kal subah ya shaam ka time hai batao mujhe kaunsa time theek rahega main ghar pe rehunga pickup boy ko andar bhej dunga"},{"text":"namaste madam aapki flight aaj shaam ko delayed hai yeh flight ai seven three two delhi se mumbai jaane wali hai lagbhag do ghante ka delay hai aap apne registered mobile number par otp check kar lein aur app update kar lein dhanyawad"},{"text":"haan hello main hotel booking ke liye call kar raha tha mera naam arjun hai aur meri booking confirm ho gayi hai check in time shaam ko paanch baje hai bas aap thoda early bata dena mujhe rasta samajh aa jayega theek hai bye bye"}]}

{"items":[{"text":"Hello, I am at your gate with the parcel. Sir, the delivery code is needed to unlock the box. Can you please share the four digit code from your SMS? I am standing right here, just need to verify before I hand it over."},{"text":"Bhaiya, main gate pe hoon cab lekar. App mein ride-start code dikh raha hai, usko bol do. OTP type karne mein time lag raha hai, bas woh code bata do taaki meter start ho jaye. Location sahi hai, bas code chahiye."},{"text":"Namaste, main courier se bol raha hoon. Kya aap address confirm kar sakte hain? Flat number 402, aur landmark ke paas wali badi bakery. Yeh sahi hai na? Ek baar verify kar lo, phir pickup complete kar dunga. Address galat hua to wapas trouble hogi."},{"text":"Caller: Good evening, front desk se bol raha hoon. Sir, aapki booking ke liye ek code chahiye verification ke liye. Person: Haan, bataiye. Caller: Sir, woh code aapke email par aaya hoga, ek baar check karke batayenge? Person: Oh haan, ek second. Caller: Theek hai sir, main wait kar raha hoon."}]}
